findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices. findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - Store does not have a 3 compartment sink for cleaning and sanitizing equipment. For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing of utensils and equipment, a sink with no fewer then three compartments shall be provided and used. The McDonald's Store Manager, Mike Potthoff, said an arrangement could be made to allow for Love's employees to use the ware washing sinks in McDonald's. Create a written policy for this and provide a copy at the follow up inspection. Proper wash, rinse, and sanitize procedure must begin immediately.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text: 750.820 - After speaking with management it was determined that food contact surfaces are not being properly washed and sanitized. Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). McDonald's has quaternary ammonia based sanitizer that can be used in their ware washing sink. McDonald's Store Manager, Mike Potthoff, said an arrangement could be made with Love's employees to use the ware washing sinks at McDonald's. Properly wash, rinse, and sanitize all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed every day. Manual wash, rinse, and sanitize handout was provided. Proper cleaning and sanitizing is to begin immediately.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean

For items that can not be cleaned and sanitized in a 3 compartment sink, properly wash, rinse, and sanitize the items in place using 3 separate containers of hot soapy wash water, warm rinse water, and sanitizer solution (100ppm chlorine or 200ppm quat).

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak in the cabinet under the coffee urns.  Fix the leak.  Do not use the cabinet for storage until leak is fixed.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed a gap between the back doors and at the bottom of one front door.  Eliminate the gaps.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed a build-up of debris on the floor under the ice maker including cups and spider webs. 
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed an unlabeled spray bottle.  Label secondary containers of contents.  Bottle was emptied.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No documentation of a licensed food handler for the facility.  Provide proof of license.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.
